metadata.description: An agent organization structured as a C-suite hierarchy. Each department installs independently so only the relevant function loads.

plugins.name: executive
plugins.description: Direction, capital and attention allocation, cross-functional arbitration, strategy validation, and the method for structuring the organization itself.

plugins.name: technology
plugins.description: Architecture, engineering delivery, development discipline, debugging, review, and AI and automation systems.

plugins.name: it-operations
plugins.description: Corporate IT: service desk, systems and network administration, endpoints, assets, identity lifecycle, and backup and recovery.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product strategy, UX and usability audit, design systems, interface craft, brand expression, and visual direction.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Positioning, content strategy and production, social and video, brand voice, copywriting, PR, and partnerships.

plugins.name: demand-generation
plugins.description: Organic and paid acquisition, conversion, measurement, experimentation, lifecycle messaging, and distribution.

plugins.name: revenue
plugins.description: Outbound, sales enablement, revenue operations, pricing and packaging, activation, retention, and referrals.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Financial modeling, budgeting and forecasting, unit economics, and financial decision support.

plugins.name: operations
plugins.description: Program management, process design, vendor and supplier management, and operational delivery.

plugins.name: pmo
plugins.description: Enterprise program management office: portfolio governance, program and project delivery, delivery risk, benefits realization, and adoption.

plugins.name: people
plugins.description: Org design, hiring and interviewing, compensation and leveling, and workforce planning.

plugins.name: legal-risk
plugins.description: Contract review, privacy and data protection, enterprise risk, compliance, and audit readiness.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Threat modeling, security architecture review, incident response, vulnerability management, and access and identity. Reviewer-class.

plugins.name: customer-experience
plugins.description: Support operations, escalation management, voice of customer, and self-service. Owns what the customer experiences after the sale.

plugins.name: data-analytics
plugins.description: Data governance, warehouse and semantic modeling, business intelligence, and AI/ML governance.

plugins.name: corporate-strategy
plugins.description: Portfolio strategy, corporate development, strategic alliances, and scenario planning.
